description: Ingest granular and/or aggregated staking rewards/balances per validator/delegator from Figment's institutional staking Rewards API (POST /{network}/rewards), across networks (Ethereum, Solana, ...), and return a pandas DataFrame.

outputs.description: DataFrame of reward records (fields vary by network) plus a network column; includes an aggregate_summary metadata attachment when include_aggregate_summary is set.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_name.label: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Key of the FigmentResource this asset depends on for authentication

time_rollup.label: Time Rollup
time_rollup.description: Granularity for network='ethereum': 'epoch' / 'daily' / 'all_time'. Not used for network='solana'.

start.label: Start
start.description: Inclusive start of the reward window (ISO-8601). ethereum-only filter.

end.label: End
end.description: Inclusive end of the reward window (ISO-8601). ethereum-only filter.

pubkeys.label: Pubkeys
pubkeys.description: Filter to specific validator public keys. ethereum-only filter.

withdrawal_addresses.label: Withdrawal Addresses
withdrawal_addresses.description: Filter to validators by withdrawal address. ethereum-only filter.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.description: Stake-account or system-account addresses. REQUIRED for network='solana' (max 50 per request).

extra_query_params.label: Extra Query Params
extra_query_params.description: Escape hatch: additional fields merged into the request body, for networks/params not modeled explicitly.

include_aggregate_summary.label: Include Aggregate Summary
include_aggregate_summary.description: When true (network='ethereum' only), issues a second time_rollup=all_time request and attaches the result as metadata.

max_pages.label: Max Pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on pagination pages followed via a next_page cursor, if present.

owners.description: Asset owners -- list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:finance', 'user@company.com']
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

name: Figment Staking Rewards Ingestion
